nodes.question: Why was Lagos State chosen for the research on sustainability and circular economic practices?
nodes.answer: Lagos State was selected because it is the most populous city in Nigeria and is currently facing challenges with the waste management systems in operation.
nodes.paragraph: So far, the country has consistently had disap - pointing environmental performance scores from vari - ous international institutions. Current estimates show that Nigeria has an environmental responsibility score of 37.9 percent and is ranked 140 out of 180 countries in the world (EPI, 2024) a truly appalling position to be in, considering her wealth of both human and natural resources. Nigeria also received poor scores and rankings in various aspects, such as climate change, waste man - agement, sanitation and drinking water, sustainability of fisheries and agriculture, air pollution, deforestation, and biodiversity protection (see Adesua Lincoln J.
